column1: # Curated concept -> publication routing table for skills/sndocs/SKILL.md.
# One row per high-traffic platform concept. Columns, tab-separated:
#   concept       lowercase, hyphenated; the term the skill matches a query
#                 against after synonym normalization
#   publication   the directory under markdown/ that is authoritative for
#                 this concept — the judgment a heading index can't supply,
#                 since several publications may mention a concept in passing
#   entry_path    a real file, verified against the australia branch on
#                 2026-08-07, relative to markdown/<publication>/ — read this
#                 first, by heading, never whole. Never a publication's
#                 index.md: SKILL.md forbids reading that file at all.
#   note          why this publication and not a plausible-looking other one
# Diffable on purpose: this is data an upstream restructure should break
# loudly (see #8), not prose that quietly drifts out of date. A row that
# never changes an eval outcome is a row to delete, not to keep for symmetry.
# concept
access-control-rule
column4: platform-security is authoritative for ACL rule creation and evaluation; application-development's "ACL access checks" material covers a different, dev-facing angle and is not the entry point

column1: business-rule
column4: server-side Business Rules live under build-workflows, not application-development, despite being written in a script editor

column1: automated-test-framework
column4: ATF is filed under application-development, not release-notes or a testing-specific publication

column1: update-set
column4: update sets are dev-lifecycle tooling, filed under application-development rather than platform-administration

column1: service-portal
column4: Service Portal (pages, widgets) is UI, not build-workflows, despite widgets containing server-side script

column1: flow-designer
column4: Flow Designer and legacy Workflow both live under build-workflows

column1: notification
column4: email/SMS notification configuration is filed under platform-administration, not integrate-applications

column1: # Glide* API questions deliberately have no row here: api-reference is the sole publication that
# could plausibly answer them, it's already in the default cone, and its entry point is the
# generated heading index (grep for the method heading), never markdown/api-reference/index.md —
# that file is the one this table exists to keep nobody from being routed toward reading whole.
